description: Place a range of an asset on a media track. The new clip id is returned in createdIds.

trackId.description: Id of the target track (VIDEO, OVERLAY or AUDIO).

assetId.description: Id of the asset to place.

startUs.description: Timeline start, in microseconds (1 second = 1000000); omit to append after the track's last clip.

sourceInUs.description: Source in point within the asset, in microseconds (1 second = 1000000).

sourceOutUs.description: Source out point within the asset, in microseconds (1 second = 1000000); omit for the asset end.

translateX.description: Horizontal offset of the clip centre from the frame centre, as a fraction of output width, -2..2. +x is right.

translateY.description: Vertical offset of the clip centre from the frame centre, as a fraction of output height, -2..2. +y is down.

scale.description: Scale, 0.01..10. 1.0 = aspect-fit inside the frame for media, natural size for captions.

rotationDeg.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees; normalized to [0, 360).

ripple.description: Insert: shift later clips on the track right to make room instead of requiring free space.
